comments.author: @wesmcdonald7624
comments.text: The DGM model appears to me to boil down to an evolutionary approach to optimize a cost function. Years age we used such a method to design an antenna consisting of multiple elements placed in a random “array” to create a beam with minimal side lobes and forward gain in a desired direction.  In that case of course the problem was far simpler than what is done here with the AI as the trade space is huge and the cost functions involved are complicated as all.  But evolutionary approaches such as RL etc can definitely generate optimized results.  Survival of the fittest is indeed a proven paradigm.  I note that tree searches might leave a fruitful branch behind based on prior decisions.  This has a parallel to evolution of life on earth where we find the variety of species, perhaps each the result of a specific branch taken by evolution — the branch that lead to a frog made an optimized amphibian but excluded it from having opposing thumbs.

comments.author: @spacecadet4902
comments.text: It's not clear what the inputs are.  Do the models have access to all information in the moment?  News flashes, tsunamis, wars, election results, earnings, revenue etc?  or is that part of the question?  If you limit the scope of available information in the moment to the markets themselves, then we can predict that no matter what intelligence is interpreting the data, the movement of any given ticker is Brownian, its random, it is unknowable.  You can get a short term advantage and make a ton of money but any such strategy if known by even one other investor, the gains will drop in half.  If the strategy is known to everyone the advantage goes to zero.  When you start betting on a secret strategy, it loses its secrecy, it becomes visible.  Looking at the buy and hold approach, AI could provide a benefit.  But you would end up in the same place as the investor who uses her wits alone:  companies that make money persist.  Companies that make increasing revenues grow in value.  Buy companies that make increasing revenues and hold them and become wealthy.  Regardless of what AI does.
